Describe the concrete problem and the behavior after this change.

## Validation

List the checks you ran and any relevant environment details.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change stays within the scope in `CONTRIBUTING.md`.
- [ ] User-facing commands, configuration, and security assumptions are documented.
- [ ] Tests cover the behavior, or the validation notes explain why they do not.
- [ ] Logs, screenshots, fixtures, commits, and commit messages contain no credentials, private URLs, or identifying machine data.
